product: Genie Code is now available as a Lakeflow Jobs task (Beta)
tagline: You can now run prompts with Genie Code as a task in a Lakeflow Job.
what_it_does: You can now run prompts with Genie Code as a task in a Lakeflow Job. Genie Code runs your prompt autonomously. It can read upstream task outputs and call tools as needed.
plain_summary: You can now run prompts with Genie Code as a task in a Lakeflow Job. Genie Code runs your prompt autonomously.
key_takeaway: You can now run prompts with Genie Code as a task in a Lakeflow Job.
